novel_features.name: Charge & Edit Calendar
novel_features.description: Every upcoming cycle's charge date, edit-lock deadline, and delivery date in one timeline so you never miss an edit window or get surprised by a charge.
novel_features.rationale: Requires combining /delivery/summary (deliveryDate) and /delivery/v2/calendar (reschedule config) and computing charge=−7d, lock=−5d offsets. No single API endpoint returns this compound view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to know whether the edit window is still open before modifying a recurring basket.

novel_features.name: Basket Diff
novel_features.description: Compares your current recurring basket against a previous cycle's snapshot to show exactly what was added, dropped, or re-quantified before the template locks.
novel_features.rationale: Requires snapshotting basket state to local SQLite and diffing against a prior snapshot — no API tracks basket-over-time history.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to verify what changed in the basket since the last confirmed delivery cycle.

novel_features.name: Price Watch
novel_features.description: Tracks the price history of the SKUs you actually buy and alerts when one rises or drops meaningfully versus your own purchase baseline.
novel_features.rationale: Requires correlating synced catalog prices across multiple sync runs — no API endpoint exposes historical price data.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to know if a subscribed product has changed price significantly since the last order.

novel_features.name: Restock Predictor
novel_features.description: Predicts when you'll run out of each staple from your historical buying cadence and suggests what to add to the upcoming basket.
novel_features.rationale: Requires analysing order history cadence across synced orders data — no API endpoint answers 'when will you run out'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to pre-populate a recurring basket with items likely running low before the next cycle.

novel_features.name: Catalog Drift Detector
novel_features.description: Flags products you buy that were discontinued, silently swapped, or kept their price while shrinking the pack, surfacing the real R$/kg or R$/L change.
novel_features.rationale: Requires comparing catalog snapshots across sync runs to detect substitution, discontinuation, and pack-size changes — invisible from any single API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to audit whether the recurring basket still contains the same products as originally added.

novel_features.name: Cashback Threshold Optimizer
novel_features.description: Computes the cheapest set of items to add (or whether to wait) to cross the next cashback tier, favoring things you'll need anyway.
novel_features.rationale: Requires combining live cart/summary cashback fields with local catalog data to compute the cheapest tier-crossing additions.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent is finalising a basket and wants to maximise cashback return before the edit window closes.

novel_features.name: Cross-Store Checkout Preview
novel_features.description: Aggregates cart totals, next delivery date, charge date, minimum-order status, and accepted payment types into one pre-checkout view before you open the browser.
novel_features.rationale: Combines siteapi cart/summary + delivery/summary + features/stores payment params and computes charge-date offset — no single endpoint returns a checkout summary.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to confirm basket readiness and charge schedule before directing the user to open the browser for final payment.

narrative.headline: Every Shopper storefront in one CLI — catalog, cart, delivery schedule, charge calendar, and spend analytics no web UI surfaces.
narrative.value_prop: shopper-pp-cli covers all six Shopper storefronts (Compra Programada, Fresh, Pet, Compra Única, Now, Now Bebidas) with correct store/cluster scoping, full siteapi REST surface, browser-deep-link helpers for subscription mutations, and a local SQLite layer for offline product search, basket diffs, price tracking, and cross-store spend rollup.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set SHOPPER_TOKEN to your Shopper JWT (from the siteapi Authorization header in browser DevTools). Run 'shopper-pp-cli doctor' to verify. The token is long-lived for the subscription cycle. Never store raw card numbers or CPF in config; card management always opens the browser.

quickstart.comment: Verify CLI is installed and config path is set before auth
Discover all six storefronts with IDs and payment parameters
See current basket total, cashback tier, and minimum-order status
See charge date, edit-lock deadline, and delivery date for the next cycle
Month-over-month actual spend rolled up across all storefronts
Full pre-checkout summary before opening browser to confirm payment

troubleshoots.fix: Run 'shopper-pp-cli auth set-token <token>' with a fresh JWT from browser DevTools → Network → Authorization header

troubleshoots.symptom: cart list-summary returns wrong store data
troubleshoots.fix: Pass --store explicitly: programada, fresh, unica, pet, now, or now-bebidas. The default is programada.
orders spend queries all stores by default; if a store shows no data, your account has no orders there

troubleshoots.symptom: delivery calendar shows no available dates
troubleshoots.fix: Run --store with a subscription store (programada/fresh/pet). now/now-bebidas use a different ultra-fast delivery flow.

troubleshoots.symptom: checkout open or delivery reschedule shows wrong store URL
troubleshoots.fix: Pass --store explicitly to get the correct storefront URL (e.g. --store fresh opens fresh.shopper.com.br)

narrative.when_to_use: Use shopper-pp-cli when automating Shopper basket management, monitoring charge schedules, analyzing spend patterns across storefronts, or building agent workflows around the Shopper subscription cycle. Ideal for recurring-basket optimization, pre-cycle audit, and delivery-schedule awareness.
anti_triggers: Do not use for placing orders or confirming checkout — use checkout open to hand off to the browser
Do not use for adding or removing saved credit cards — card management requires browser session
Do not use for ultra-fast delivery slot selection on now/now-bebidas — delivery slots for these stores require the browser checkout flow
Do not use for cancelling orders — cancellation is not available via siteapi REST

recipes.explanation: Returns the key dates for the next cycle; compare edit_lock_date to today to know if the basket can still be changed.

recipes.title: Find items to add for next cashback tier
recipes.explanation: Computes the cheapest catalog additions to cross the next cashback threshold using your live cart and synced product data.

recipes.title: Cross-store spend rollup for last 6 months
recipes.explanation: Queries all 6 storefronts and returns a month-by-store spend matrix for budgeting analysis.

recipes.title: Detect if a subscribed product changed price
recipes.explanation: Scans synced price history for products in your basket and flags meaningful price movements.

recipes.explanation: Aggregates cart/delivery/payment data so an agent can confirm basket readiness before directing the user to open the checkout browser.
